subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close, adopt, or replace the open conflicting fork PR before queueing a fresh active-runtime fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open fork PR still claims the closing relationship while targeting the removed handler path, so automation should not create a duplicate fix path until maintainers choose the canonical route.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or mark the fork PR as superseded, then let a narrow PR fix `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to rebase and narrow
options.body: Keep the fork PR as the candidate only if the author moves it to the active runtime path, removes unrelated edits, resolves conflicts, and adds real Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the current fork PR, accepting that the reported bug remains unfixed on main and in the latest release.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or mark the fork PR as superseded, then let a narrow PR fix `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the native approval lifecycle and active Telegram runtime shape that the fix should use.
